entry_state: Named origins with documented exact offset permit traceable stopped-reserve attribution in the restricted example. Frozen gain, later undesignated gain and signed reserve releases reconcile separately. Cancellation versus occurrence changes attached inventory basis; intermediate funding and unresolved general heterogeneous attribution remain explicit. exit_state: Receiving all hedged inventory transfers its attached reserve directly into cost, without new cash or income. Subsequent sales and write-downs track a homogeneous batch's gross cost and allowance, not another hedge-reserve release. The partial-sale example now derives proportional allowance removal before the next valuation.
